Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger A creature reduces you or a living ally within 30 feet to 0 Hit Points.

You can trigger this action even while dying. You can channel the power of death into a poisonous spite. The triggering creature takes @Damage[4d4[persistent,poison]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:spell|basic] save against your spell DC. If the creature kills you or your ally as part of the trigger, the creature gets a result one degree of success worse than it rolls on this save.
